'''Bonekrusher Vanguard''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A Bonekrusher combatant armed with spears and shields. Though armed with weapons crudely cobbled together, the vanguard has developed a combat technique that unites attack and defense. Practice caution when fighting this foe.}}

==Overview==
A Bonekrusher wielding spear and shield: Unless they are attacking, they will block all incoming attack directed at them, which greatly reduces the damage they take, indicated by a shield icon next to the floating damage number, making them a though nut to crack. If the Bonekrusher Vanguard becomes {{Color|Staggered|8}}, their shield will shatter, taking away their option of blocking attacks. Making them unable to move through actions like {{G|Lift}}, {{G|Knock Down}}, {{G|Crush}} or {{G|Solidification}} also temporarily stops them from blocking attacks.

When not attacked, they instead attack with a spear thrust, or a spear swing and slam dealing Physical damage.
